Flood relief camps house 40,000 in north Bihar

PTI | Supaul: Relief camps across six flood-affected districts of north Bihar are currently housing nearly 40,000 displaced people, officials said on Sunday.

Community kitchens are serving cooked meals twice daily, while medical teams screen inmates for water-borne diseases.

The disaster management department said 120 boats and 14 NDRF teams remain deployed for evacuation and relief distribution.

With river levels receding, authorities have begun assessing crop and house damage for compensation disbursal.

Officials said gratuitous relief would be transferred directly to beneficiaries' bank accounts within a fortnight.
